title: Jerked Crisp Algerian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and crispy Algerian dish featuring jerk seasoning and tandoor spices, perfect for a crowd, this paleo-friendly recipe is a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together jerk seasoning, tandoor spice blend, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through and slightly charred.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
